about.heading: What I bring to a team.
pillar.1.title: I enjoy learning new things
pillar.1.body: When I meet a new technology I look beyond how to use it to why it came about and which problems it solves. Lately I've been building my skills in AWS, Kubernetes, OpenShift and LiteLLM.
pillar.2.title: I don't use AI just to write code
pillar.2.body: Before I start coding I plan what to do and pin down the requirements. Even when I get help from AI, I don't use code I don't understand; I test it, verify it and change it when needed.
pillar.3.title: I think about the whole system, not just the code
pillar.3.body: I have worked on backends, databases, message queues and frontend integrations, and I'm also involved in CI/CD and cloud deployment. I care not only that a feature works, but how it will behave in a real environment.
pillar.4.title: I try to understand a problem before solving it
pillar.4.body: When something doesn't work, I look into the cause instead of reaching for a temporary fix. I weigh different approaches and try to apply what I learn in my next projects.
